# Krate

Krate lets developers package software as one .krate file that runs through native Krate runtimes on macOS, Windows and Linux.

The recipient installs a compatible Krate runtime once. Applications use supported Krate APIs; existing desktop binaries do not become portable without adaptation.

The Krate runtime is free and open source (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Studio has separate licensing; see the repository license details. Krate Studio provides AI-assisted app creation and revision. Developers can also build against the Rust SDK. Optional hosted services are separate from the local runtime and file format.

A .krate bundle contains a WebAssembly component and manifest, and can also carry source, SDK interfaces and assets. Full bundle bytes, uncompressed code payload, runtime download and installed runtime size are different measurements.

Applications begin without file or network access and receive approved capabilities through the runtime. This boundary is not a guarantee of bug-free or harmless software; review the threat model and only run apps you trust.

## Scoped benchmark

The following is the recorded 2026-08-25 notes comparison, not a measurement of the latest release or all Krate apps.
MarkText 0.17.1 ARM64 vs the Krate notes replica, Apple M4, macOS 27 (build 26A5388g), on AC power; equivalent-workload comparison, not feature parity.

- Historical code payload versus installed application: Krate 36.6 KiB; MarkText 284.6 MiB installed.
- memory, 50,000-line document: Krate 178.5 MiB, one process; MarkText 2,299.4 MiB across four processes.
- warm start to a visible window, 50,000-line document: Krate 237.1 ms median; MarkText 611.5 ms median.

The historical Krate runtime was installed separately at 88.6 MiB. The 36.6 KiB payload is not the total first-install cost. Warm open is the median of ten runs per app; memory includes the whole process tree.

Energy was not measured. Source-bearing bundles and assets add to the historical code payload; the published analysis does not establish the current full-bundle install ratio.

Analysis: https://github.com/incyashraj/krate/blob/main/evidence/benchmarks/marktext-vs-krate/runs/20260825T085644Z/analysis.md
The public benchmark kit contains the protocol, analysis and seal. Retained raw run data is not all distributed in the public checkout.
